messages:
Anna K.: quick check — where's the canonical TTFT + tokens/sec dashboard for runtime streaming paths? oncall asked for p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec by model.
Sophia L.: the main overview is in Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/ttft_streaming/ttft-and-throughput
Sophia L.: panels to look at: 'TTFT latency (p50/p95/p99) by route', 'Tokens/sec by model', and 'Streaming token throughput heatmap'
Jared T.: for quick p95 numbers you can run this promql in the TTFT panel: ```histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))```
Jared T.: if you want p50/p99 just change the 0.95 to 0.5 or 0.99
Miguel R.: to split cold start vs warm paths we label requests: `redwood_runtime_ttft{start_type="cold"}`. Example query for cold p95: ```histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_ttft_bucket{start_type="cold"}[10m])) by (le, route))```
Anna K.: perfect — can we also get tokens/sec for a particular model + route?
Sophia L.: use: ```sum(rate(redwood_tokens_generated_total{model="gptx-8b",route=~"/chat.*"}[1m])) by (model,route)``` then divide by concurrency if you want per-request avg
Anna K.: any trace links for a slow TTFT sample (p95 around 800ms last hour)?
Jared T.: grab a trace from Jaeger with the traceID shown in the TTFT panel. quick link pattern: https://jaeger.redwood/internal/search?service=runtime&tags=%7Broute%3D%22/stream%22%7D
Jared T.: here's an example filter you can paste into Jaeger: service=redwood-runtime, operation=first-token, min-duration=200ms, tags=route:/stream
Miguel R.: alert tuning note: current ttft_p95_slo rule fires at 500ms for /stream — seems noisy during bursts. proposal: bump to 700ms and add suppression for autoscale events (label `scale=true`). Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Sophia L.: +1 to 700ms but please add a short-term cooldown (5m) in the alertmanager route for `autoscale=true`. otherwise oncall gets paged repeatedly during scale-ups
Anna K.: can you file a quick PR with the updated rule and alertmanager route? tag me and oncall so I can review tonight
Miguel R.: will do — PR to infra/alerts in a bit. cc @DeployBot to note upcoming change
DeployBot: deploy queued: infra/alerts#482 (miguelr/ttft-alert-tuning) — will run CI and notify on success :gear:
Anna K.: thanks all, this is enough for the oncall reply. I'll paste the Grafana + Jaeger links and the suggested promql into the incident note. :thumbsup:
